definitions.explanation: Making something simpler or shorter by removing unnecessary complexity or detail. Describes both the act and the resulting state of being simplified.

examples.japanese: {手続|てつづ}きを{簡略化|かんりゃくか}する。
{簡略|かんりゃく}な{説明|せつめい}でお{願|ねが}いします。
{報告書|ほうこくしょ}の{書式|しょしき}を{簡略化|かんりゃくか}したおかげで、{作成|さくせい}{時間|じかん}が{大幅|おおはば}に{短縮|たんしゅく}された。
examples.english: Thanks to simplifying the report format, the time needed to prepare it was greatly reduced.

notes:
Composed of {簡|かん} (simple/brief) and {略|りゃく} (abbreviation/omission). Often used with {化|か} as {簡略化|かんりゃくか} (simplification as a process) or as a na-adjective meaning 'simple/brief.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {簡略化|かんりゃくか}: simplification (as a process)
- {簡略化|かんりゃくか}する: to simplify
- {簡略|かんりゃく}な{説明|せつめい}: brief explanation
- {簡略|かんりゃく}な{手順|てじゅん}: simplified procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {簡潔|かんけつ}: concise / succinct — emphasizes clarity and being to the point
- {省略|しょうりゃく}: omission / abbreviation — focuses on leaving things out
- {簡素|かんそ}: simple / plain — emphasizes lack of decoration or ornamentation
- {略|りゃく}: abbreviation — a shorter form of a word or phrase
